nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Logistic Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level LogisticRegression and LogisticRegressionCV estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above liblinear, SciPy/sklearn optimizer, SAG/SAGA, CV scoring, and refit boundaries.

nodes.name: logistic_public_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public logistic estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: logistic_public_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return whether a public logistic estimator is the direct or cross-validated family.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: logistic_public_solver_boundary
nodes.description: Return the optimizer or native solver boundary selected by a public logistic estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed solver labels.

nodes.name: logistic_public_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level logistic routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for covered logistic estimators.

nodes.name: logistic_public_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public logistic fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing solver, CV, or refit callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None, params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and sample weights, then packages references without fitting.

nodes.name: logistic_public_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public logistic prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction or scoring to sklearn.

nodes.name: logistic_public_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public logistic estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: logistic_public_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted classes, coefficients, intercepts, iteration counts, solver metadata, and CV-selected grids after deferred logistic execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes fitted coefficient arrays, class labels, and optional CV grid arrays already produced by sklearn fitting.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 and Case 4 public logistic estimator shells over liblinear, SciPy/sklearn optimizer, SAG/SAGA, cross-validation scoring, and refit boundaries
limitations: The internal fitted-state topology is obscured by liblinear, SciPy/sklearn optimizer, SAG/SAGA native solver, CV scoring, and refit boundaries.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not solver convergence, validation execution, class encoding internals, CV fold generation, scorer callbacks, refit calls, prediction, or scoring internals.
